options.name: client_cert
options.description: Client certificate content for remote authentication. Requires O(url) and O(client_key). Mutually exclusive with O(token) and O(client_cert_path).

options.name: client_cert_path
options.description: Client certificate path for remote authentication. Requires O(url) and O(client_key_path). Mutually exclusive with O(token) and O(client_cert).

options.name: client_key
options.description: Client key content for remote authentication. Requires O(url) and O(client_cert). Mutually exclusive with O(client_key_path).

options.name: client_key_path
options.description: Client key path for remote authentication. Requires O(url) and O(client_cert_path). Mutually exclusive with O(client_key).

options.name: config
options.description: Configuration key-value pairs. Boolean values are converted to lowercase strings. Dict values for C(cloud-init.*) keys are serialized to YAML.

options.name: description
options.description: Instance description.

options.name: devices
options.description: Devices as a list. Each item must include a C(name) field used as the device key in the Incus API. Boolean values are converted to lowercase strings.

options.name: ephemeral
options.description: Whether the instance is ephemeral (deleted on stop). Set on creation only. Cannot be changed afterwards.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the instance.

options.name: profiles
options.description: List of profiles to apply to the instance.

options.name: project
options.description: Incus project to query.

options.name: server_cert
options.description: Server certificate content for remote verification. Requires O(url). Mutually exclusive with O(server_cert_path).

options.name: server_cert_path
options.description: Server certificate path for remote verification. Requires O(url). Mutually exclusive with O(server_cert).

options.name: socket_path
options.description: Incus Unix socket path for local connections.

options.name: source
options.description: Image reference to copy from, e.g. C(images:debian/13), C(ubuntu/24.04), or C(docker:library/nginx). C(remote:alias) format auto-resolves well-known remotes (C(images), C(ubuntu), C(ubuntu-daily), C(docker)).

options.name: source_protocol
options.description: Protocol used to communicate with O(source_server).

options.name: source_server
options.description: URL of the image server to pull from, e.g. C(https://images.linuxcontainers.org). Takes precedence over auto-resolved remotes when O(source) uses the C(remote:alias) format.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the instance. C(started) ensures the instance exists and is running. C(stopped) ensures the instance exists and is stopped. C(restarted) restarts the instance if it is running. C(absent) ensures the instance does not exist.

options.name: target
options.description: Cluster member to place the instance on. Only used during creation. Ignored for existing instances.

options.name: token
options.description: Token for remote authentication. Requires O(url). Mutually exclusive with O(client_cert).

options.name: type
options.description: Instance type. Set on creation only. Cannot be changed afterwards.

options.name: url
options.description: Remote Incus server URL (e.g. https://host:8443). If specified, connects via HTTPS instead of Unix socket.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Server TLS certificate validation.

options.name: wait
options.description: Async operation completion wait. Set to C(false) for fire-and-forget behaviour.
